authors_reviews.title: I love it!
authors_reviews.text: Beautiful lamp and the glass feels a bit wobbly, but when a multi colour changing light, or a mono color light is put in, looks magnificent either way. I’m going to buy more, but not from this seller. Also acts as a pretty bookend. My altar looks of a masterpiece and a big thanks is towards this lamp! In the last photo, I’m using a mono color tea light which is noticeably brighter compared to the other photos. It would look great inside or outdoors. Also, easy to carry; not heavy OR bulky. I haven’t, however, tested flamed candles, only flame- less.
authors_reviews.author: Lara

authors_reviews.title: Lovely garden lighting
authors_reviews.text: Bought two and have put candle lights with a timer in them. They look lovely at night. Quite light material/metal - wouldn't want to drop one!!! - but they are just what I wanted for my pergola.
authors_reviews.author: S. Hurst

authors_reviews.title: Would have been a 5* but......
authors_reviews.text: Loved the look and size of this the colour was perfect, I was disappointed all other colour's were a lot cheaper but it had to be purple.When it arrived I was pleasantly surprised, until I tried to close the door, all bent and twisted, I managed to twist and pull it back into shape of opening, still wouldn't close or stayed closed to be precise, the little press tag catch was also bent almost back on itself, sorted this out and it's closing and staying closed, hence the 4 star rating, don't be put off, it's still lovely and can be used to light my wife's memorial candles with a nice purple glow to the room.
authors_reviews.author: Susan Lawson

authors_reviews.title: Great quality lantern
authors_reviews.text: I bought this as a present for my uncle as he likes this type of decorative item. He was very pleased with the quality of the lantern. Its a great size and the decoration on the metal body and glass has been expertly done.We tried it with a tea light candle in and looked great. The glass lets you see the glow of the candle and you don’t have to worry about it getting too warm with it being made from metal and glass.A great item and i would recommend.
authors_reviews.author: Graham

authors_reviews.title: Amazing and beautiful lanterns
authors_reviews.text: These lanterns are absolutely beautiful especially with candles in, they leave a beautiful pattern on the ceiling.They are amazing quality made with iron and fake glass, highly recommend buying them you won’t regret it.😀
authors_reviews.author: Ari clucas

authors_reviews.title: all i can say is WOW
authors_reviews.text: I ordered the largest size thinking that it was probably a rip-off, but when it arrived it was absolutely MASSIVE and so beautiful! Really well packed as well, and included a spare glass panel. I thought at first the door didn't latch, but it turned out that I just needed to remove all the foam. There are also instructions in case the door latch isn't working or panels are loose, which shows attention to detail.The colour is very vibrant and strong, and just as pictured. I got purple but there is a wide range of colours.This is a quality item, well made and should last a very long time. Was actually worth the price after all. Very happy.
authors_reviews.author: Edgar A. Poe
